notes: T2 is written AGAINST T1 and is the fixture for C5. The delta is exactly four items: 2 modified (T1-R01, T1-R06), 1 contradicted (T1-R13), 1 added (chart comments). THE TRAP: T2 restates four T1 requirements almost verbatim - the pilot date (T1-R05), CSV export (T1-R07), SAML SSO (T1-R09) and row-level scoping (T1-R10). These are listed in unchanged_restated and must NOT appear anywhere in the delta. Any of them appearing as added, modified or contradicted is churn, and C5 requires churn = 0. The audit log (T1-R11) is a fifth trap of a weaker kind: it is reaffirmed ('Still on, still as written, no change.') without being restated in full, so it is not an extractable requirement of T2 and must equally not appear in the delta. prd_quote on the contradicted item is a verbatim substring of T1's raw_text, not T2's - it names the position being contradicted; new_quote is the T2 substring. T2-Q02's quote overlaps T2-R02's second quote region; that is deliberate and permitted, an open question and a requirement may be drawn from the same sentence. T1-R01 is scored as modified, not contradicted: a relaxed number is a change of degree. T1-R13 is scored as contradicted, not modified, because the new position asserts the opposite of what the old one forbade.
